title: Do tabular foundation models lift on the certified 285-feature rich view (the feature-deficit hypothesis for the FLM family)?
motivation: All seven FLM screens were NEGATIVE on the champion's raw-22 route view (plateau ~0.956-0.957, port_delta ~-1e-3). Phase 20 then CONFIRMED the feature-deficit hypothesis for the neural family: the same architectures gained ~+2.3e-3 standalone AUC on the certified 285-feature rich view (e.g. DCNv2 0.957580 -> 0.959898; PLR-MLP 0.957 -> 0.960197). FLMs are the most decorrelated family measured against the champion (logit-Pearson ~0.984-0.986 on the route view) but too weak; if the same ~+2.3e-3 feature lift applies while decorrelation survives, an FLM could cross BOTH screening conditions (standalone near champion AND corr < 0.995) that no family has achieved so far. This is a MECHANISM CHANGE (feature view), not a rerun of the closed route-view recipes: each candidate sees exactly one new factor versus its frozen phase-19 screen result, giving a paired route-vs-rich comparison per model.

scope.cannot: pass the OOF admission gate; justify a submission; or establish private performance
scope.purpose: decide whether any FLM merits a full 5-fold OOF + admission-gate run on the rich view

protocol.feature_representation: the certified rich view 'full' (237 static transductive/external features + 48 fold-safe target encodings = 285) built by src/features/view.py ViewBuilder.assemble -- the exact view behind the champion's aux10 boosted-tree arms
protocol.target_encoding: fold-safe TE only: FIT rows inner-cross-fit (own label excluded), EVAL rows encoded by a FIT-fitted table; EVAL labels never read

context.kind: stratified subsample of FIT (folds 1-4) for in-context learning
context.fold_safe: context is a subset of FIT; never contains a fold-0 row
context.note: context stays 20k (identical to the phase-19 route-view screens) so the ONLY changed factor vs the frozen route results is the feature view

protocol.eval_rows: full fold-0 (139927 rows; lower-noise than the 50k subscreens used for the route-view reference numbers)
protocol.harness: scripts/phase19/foundation_screen_fold0.py --view full (gained the --view flag for this screen)

candidate_notes.tabicl: TabICL-v2, route-view reference AUC 0.956343 / port_delta -1.394e-3 / corr 0.9843
candidate_notes.causilo: Causilo (causal discovery + TabPFN), route-view reference AUC 0.956684 / port_delta -1.011e-3 / corr 0.9863 (best FLM on route)
candidate_notes.tabdpt: TabDPT, context_reduction=subsample, compile=False, use_flash=False (sm_120), route-view reference AUC 0.956238 / port_delta -1.410e-3 / corr 0.9847
candidate_notes.xrfm: xRFM recursive feature machine, route-view reference AUC ~0.9306 / port_delta -9.3e-3 (weakest; kept as the strongest possible feature-lift test since it is maximally feature-starved)
candidate_notes.excluded: tabfm (jax backend; negative at 2k context, low expected lift); mitra/kumo (resource-closed at feasible scale); LimiX/EXAONE (license-blocked)

metrics.paired_reference: each model's own frozen phase-19 route-view screen result (same protocol, same context, same champion hashes; eval subset differs: 50k then, 139927 now -- port_delta sign/magnitude comparisons are treated as indicative, not exact)

decision_rule.CLOSE_FLMS_RICH: if every candidate has portfolio_delta < +5e-5, the FLM x rich-view direction is closed: either the feature lift does not transfer to in-context learners, or decorrelation collapses onto the redundancy frontier (corr >= 0.995), or both. No further FLM view/context variants without a new mechanism.
decision_rule.note: PROMISING only means 'run full 5-fold OOF + admission gate'. The admission gate (mean paired fold gain >= 1.5e-5, >= 2.5x paired SE, positive in >= 4 of 5 folds) still applies and can only be evaluated on full OOF.

anti_leakage: TE features are fold-safe: FIT rows inner-cross-fit excluding own label, EVAL rows encoded by a FIT-fitted table; EVAL labels never read (tests/test_pipeline.py guards).
Context rows are a subset of FIT (folds 1-4); no fold-0 row is ever in context.
The champion reference (route/portfolio) is loaded from hash-asserted phase17_B1 artifacts (portfolio sha 1981745c..., route sha bcb28113...).

Context rows' TE features may encode labels of OTHER FIT rows (transductive within the training fold) exactly as in the neural full-view screen and the champion's own aux arms; this is fold-safe with respect to the applied fold-0 rows.

budget.gpu: inference-only, RTX 5070 Ti 16 GB, <=1 GPU job at a time; estimates <= 1.5 GPU-h total including the richer per-row token cost

predeclared_followups: Any PROMISING candidate gets a full 5-fold OOF with inner cross-fitting and the admission gate.
A negative closes FLM x rich-view; reopening requires a genuinely different mechanism (e.g. supervised fine-tuning, item 31/35), not another view/context tweak.
Context-scaling ladder (queue rank 7) remains CONDITIONAL and only on a positive fold-0 trajectory.
